entries.name: Suburban house
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Kenney City Kit Suburban)

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Kenney building-type-e (GLB + Textures/colormap.png), chosen over the plan's building-type-a: a compact two-storey gable house with a pent eave (hisashi) between the floors, which also passes for a Japanese suburban home. Height 8 m to the roof ridge (two storeys; at 7 m the stylized door was only 1.6 m tall); at 8 m it is 9.1 m wide and 7.2 m deep with a ~1.85 m door. Single mesh: the porch shrubs share the roof's texture colour, so they take the roof role (read as red azaleas). Static, no clips.
